note: Fixed Text Link Formatter provides exactly two field formatter plugins and nothing else (no settings form, no configure route, no permissions, no services, no Drush). fixed_text_link (label 'Link with fixed text') formats core link fields and extends LinkFormatter; fixed_text_file_url (label 'Link with a fixed text') formats file fields. All persistent state is a per-field formatter component in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<view_mode>: content.<field>.type = fixed_text_link|fixed_text_file_url plus settings.link_text (required) / link_class / allow_override (link) / open_in_new_window (file). Medium cases read back the configured link_text of a seeded link field and file field; hard cases switch a field's display formatter to the fixed-text formatter with a fixed link_text, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: I have a link field on my Drupal Article content type and I want every link to always display the same text like 'Visit our website' regardless of the URL. Which formatter from the fixed_text_link_formatter module do I use, and what is the key setting?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage display, choose the 'Link with fixed text' formatter (id fixed_text_link) and set its 'Link text' (link_text) setting to 'Visit our website'. It is stored on the entity_view_display component.

evals.prompt: Which field types can the fixed_text_link_formatter module's formatters be applied to, and what are the two formatter plugin ids?
evals.expected_output: fixed_text_link applies to core 'link' fields; fixed_text_file_url applies to 'file' fields. Those are the two formatters the module provides.

evals.prompt: In the fixed_text_link_formatter 'Link with fixed text' formatter, what does the 'Allow override' (allow_override) setting do?
evals.expected_output: When allow_override is enabled, the configured fixed link text is only applied to link items that have no title of their own; a per-item title is kept. When disabled, the fixed text always replaces the item title.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a link field 'field_ftlf_link' displayed with the fixed_text_link_formatter. Inspect the live default view display and tell me the exact fixed link text it is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ftlf_link component uses type fixed_text_link with settings.link_text = 'Visit Our Partner'.

evals.prompt: This site's Article content type has a file field 'field_ftlf_file' formatted with the fixed_text_file_url formatter. Read the live default display configuration and state the fixed link text used for the file link.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ftlf_file component uses type fixed_text_file_url with settings.link_text = 'Download the Report'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a link field 'field_ftlf_task' currently shown with the core Link formatter on the default view display. Using the fixed_text_link_formatter module, change its display formatter to the fixed-text link formatter and give it a fixed link text (for example 'Read more'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_ftlf_task component on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type fixed_text_link with a non-empty settings.link_text (e.g. 'Read more'), via Manage display or setComponent()->save().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a file field 'field_ftlf_taskfile' shown with the default file formatter on the default view display. Using the fixed_text_link_formatter module, make it render as a link with fixed text (for example 'Download') and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_ftlf_taskfile component on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to type fixed_text_file_url with a non-empty settings.link_text (e.g. 'Download').
